name: Bobbin Lace
desc: Handmade bobbin lace laid on dark velvet — a twisted point-ground net threaded with cloth-stitch flower medallions, gimp-outlined petals and edging picots in pale ecru, gold, or black Chantilly silk, drifting slowly as candlelight glints travel across the threads.

style.doc: ecru lace on wine velvet / black Chantilly on pale grey / metallic gold / cyan net schematic / icy frost-web
